title: Triangulated Koszul comparison and twisted cup pairing for lattice actions
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $r\geq0$, let $D=\mathbf Z^r$ be discrete, and let $\mathcal A_R(D)$ be the category of internal $R$-modules with $D$-action [def-sfb-condensed-action-module, sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Use ordinary derived categories and derived invariants [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus]. For a module $P$ whose commuting action operators are $T_1,\ldots,T_r$, use the finite cochain complex $K_R(P;T)$, its signs, and its invariant inclusion from [lem-sfb-discrete-lattice-koszul-resolution]. For a bounded-below complex $P^\bullet$ of such modules, let $K_R(P^\bullet;T)$ denote the total complex of these finite Koszul complexes, with differential $d_K+(-1)^a d_P$ in Koszul degree $a$.

These total complexes induce a triangulated functor $\mathsf K_R:D^+(\mathcal A_R(D))\to D^+(\operatorname{Mod}_R)$. The natural Koszul comparisons of [lem-sfb-discrete-lattice-koszul-resolution] admit a simultaneous choice extending to an isomorphism of triangulated functors
$$\lambda:\mathsf K_R\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_{R,D}.$$
In particular, for every short exact sequence of equivariant modules, the comparison identifies the connecting morphism of its termwise exact Koszul sequence with the image under $R\Gamma_{R,D}$ of its canonical short-exact-sequence connecting morphism. It retains the invariant-inclusion normalization and is the identity for $r=0$.

For this same choice of $\lambda$, let $B$ be a commutative internal $R$-algebra with commuting $R$-algebra automorphisms $T_i$. Assume $B$ is flat over $R$, meaning that $B\otimes_R-$ is exact on internal modules. Write $K_B=K_R(B;T)$. The bounded complex $K_B$ is K-flat, meaning that tensoring it with any acyclic complex gives an acyclic total complex. There is a chain pairing $\star:K_B\otimes_R K_B\to K_B$ given, for homogeneous tuples $x\in K_B^p$, $y\in K_B^q$ and $|I|=p+q$, by
$$(x\star y)_I=\sum_{A\sqcup C=I,\ |A|=p}\epsilon(A,C)\,x_A\,T_A(y_C),\qquad T_A=\prod_{i\in A}T_i,$$
where $\epsilon(A,C)=(-1)^{\#\{(a,c)\in A\times C:c<a\}}$, and the empty product of operators is the identity. The invariant unit $R[0]\to K_B$ is $1_B$ in Koszul degree zero. In the derived category, with the ordinary tensor of the K-flat model representing derived tensor, this pairing satisfies
$$\lambda_B\circ Q(\star)=\operatorname{cup}_B\circ(\lambda_B\otimes_R^{\mathrm L}\lambda_B).$$
Here $Q$ is localization at quasi-isomorphisms and $\operatorname{cup}_B:R\Gamma_{R,D}(B)\otimes_R^{\mathrm L}R\Gamma_{R,D}(B)\to R\Gamma_{R,D}(B)$ is the canonical derived cup product induced by the equivariant multiplication of $B$. For $B=R$ with the trivial action, $\operatorname{cup}_R$ is the unital derived cup product on $R\Gamma_{R,D}(R[0])$ of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus]. The comparison sends the invariant unit to the canonical derived unit. No flatness, characteristic, or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed on $R$.
